Assertion (A): The introduction of GST has removed the cascading effect of taxation.
Reason (R): Under GST, credit of taxes paid at previous stages is available as set-off, so only the value addition is taxed.
options: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
explanation: Correct option: (A). Both are true and R explains A. A cascading effect arises when tax is charged on a price that already includes tax. Because GST allows input tax credit for taxes paid at earlier stages, only the value added at each stage is taxed, which removes the tax-on-tax effect.
